recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-11203 unless a later work-group decision replaces the advisory cross-resource comment with a different enforceable conformance mechanism.
issue_request: FHIR-11203 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2. It asked for an invariant to ensure Flag duration and encounter alignment, but the final resolution said cross-resource invariants cannot be enforced and directed the addition of a Flag.encounter comment requiring Flag.period to fall within the referenced Encounter period when both are valued.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by bd9f60dbffee762fd2b3e49ee2e07e232b9685a9, which explicitly mentioned FHIR-11203 and added the requested comment to the historical Flag spreadsheet source. Later source conversion carried the guidance into source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists flag=Flag, so the current Flag StructureDefinition is in build scope. FHIR-32351 later renamed Encounter.period to Encounter.actualPeriod for actual encounter timing, and the already-published reconciliation commit 55b6972198ad1e12d56bfb6615d9df709a4f152b aligned the Flag.encounter comment with that current path. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-11203 community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Flag.encounter comment already states that if Flag.encounter and Flag.period are both valued, Flag.period.start must not be before Encounter.actualPeriod.start and Flag.period.end must not be after Encounter.actualPeriod.end.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Encounter.period to Encounter.actualPeriod for actual encounter timing, explaining why the current Flag comment differs from the original DSTU2 resolution wording.
